blocks.x: So it sounds like Bu [Art Blakey] was right around the corner now. Or do you want to . . .
How we doing with time? We good? Because when we get with Bu, that’s . . .
That’s a whole scenario right there. We got time? Kimery: There’s 15 minutes left on this.
Oh yeah. I can do it. Kimery: We have tomorrow too. So we don’t want to push you.
Why don’t we do this and finish it up with Bu then? Okay. After I left Diz, I was “at liberty,” which means, I was unemployed.
